mike_sales: FYI — Acme Corp asked for a blended pricing model that mixes Reserved + overage credits and wants unused reserved capacity converted into credits that roll forward. Ticket #3421. Can product weigh in?

sara_product: Can you paste the exact ask and their expected commit size? Blended pricing can work but we need clear launch criteria and revenue treatment.

mike_sales: They want 2x N4 reserved for 12 months, plus buffer for bursts. Proposal from them: per-token base 0.003 + overage credits counted at 50% value. Also asked that unused reserved capacity convert to credits for future months.

leo_support: Adding context from support ticket: their traffic is very spiky (big nightly batch jobs + daytime API). Also flagged a question about token accounting when prefix caching reduces billed tokens vs raw tokens.

ana_typo: (ignored placeholder)

ana_finance: Converting reserved to roll-forward credits is tricky from a revenue recognition perspective. We can consider one-time credits or short-expiry credits, but indefinite roll-forward will need legal + accounting approval.

sara_product: High-level options to propose to customer:
- Option A: Standard reserved contract + overage at published rate.
- Option B: Reserved + "burst credits" bucket (expires in 90 days) for spikes.
- Option C: Blended committed+overage rate (single per-token price).
We should pick one to scope and implement.

mike_sales: The customer prefers C, but B is acceptable if credits last at least 60-90 days. They want predictable unit economics for launch spikes. Can we offer a 90-day expiring burst credit and a 10% discount on overage?

sara_product: Need engineering input on edge cases: how does caching / prefix dedup affect our billing calculations? @leo_support any empirical numbers from their logs we can include in PRD?

leo_support: From their logs: prefix caching reduces billed token counts by ~15% on average for their request shape. Embeddings usage is a separate metered dimension and won't be covered by token credits unless explicitly included. I can attach a sample CSV of weekly usage.

sara_product: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Legal signoff on credit expiries and conversion rules
- Finance confirms revenue treatment for burst credits
- Billing flow implemented and tested for blended calc
- Docs and pricing page updated with examples
- Smoke test on a customer invoice for first month

mike_sales: I'll own customer comms and the commercial term negotiation. @ana_finance can you own the revenue/legal path? @sara_product can you own the PRD and backlog ticket?

ana_finance: :thumbsup: I can do legal + revenue review. We should avoid open-ended roll-forward credits unless we get exec signoff. 90-day expiry with clear labeling is acceptable.

deploy-bot: new ticket created: PRD-5234 assigned to sara_product (https://rwd/PRD-5234)

sara_product: Thanks. I'll draft the PRD and include a detailed pricing matrix and launch checklist. Quick mock for the pricing table I will include: 
```
Committed: 2x N4 - $X/month
Blended overage rate: $0.0027/token (10% discount)
Burst credits: 100M tokens, expires 90 days
Billing calc sample:
monthly_charge = committed_fee + max(0, usage_tokens - committed_tokens) * blended_rate
```

mike_sales: :eyes: Send the PRD when ready, we want to close this with the customer next week.

sara_product: :calendar: Aiming for EOW draft. I'll tag the backlog ticket PRD-5234 with priority P2 and list owners + acceptance criteria.

(End of thread)
